themes.consensus_view: Five desks flag the Treasury's plan to buy back its own outstanding bonds as a live topic this window, but none of them has staked out a view on whether it pushes bond prices up or down.

facts_agreed.claim: Five desks reference the US Treasury's bond buyback program as an active policy item in this window without arguing a direction.
Two desks specifically frame the buybacks as targeting the longest-dated end of the Treasury curve.

themes.consensus_view: Goldman is the only desk taking a side, arguing that established software companies can charge existing customers more by building AI into products they already use and that spare computing capacity can be rented out for extra revenue, while four other desks only flag AI monetization as a topic without picking a direction.

facts_agreed.claim: Established software vendors are building AI into their existing products using data, workflows and sales channels they already own, which lets them charge their current customer base more.
evidence_quotes: incumbent software vendors use their proprietary data, workflows and distribution to embed AI

facts_agreed.claim: Selling spare computing capacity to outside customers is treated as extra revenue upside that is not yet in the numbers.
evidence_quotes: Broadly we see the potential to externally monetize available compute capacity as upside optionality

facts_agreed.claim: Several desks flag AI monetization as the frame for reading software and cloud earnings this window without staking a directional view on it.

themes.consensus_view: Four desks keep the Strait of Hormuz on the watch list as an open shipping and oil-supply risk tied to Iran-Oman talks, but none of them has taken a side on whether the risk gets worse or fades.

facts_agreed.claim: JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs both track whether ships can still move freely through the Strait of Hormuz as the thing that matters about the region.
Mizuho International and The Market Ear both flag the strait as a live source of oil supply and political risk rather than a settled situation.
The negotiation track around the strait, covering Iran-Oman talks and how transit revenue would be split, is being watched as the path to any resolution.
